title: V1 Release Candidate Hardening Requirements Audit

requirements.title: 唯一目标
requirements.evidence: Phase 17.1 changes are release/configuration/audit scope; no new research-quality objective was introduced.

requirements.title: No Research Intelligence Changes
requirements.evidence: No Phase 17.1 change intentionally modifies Planner, retrieval, acceptance, coverage, budget, or recovery semantics.

requirements.title: Reference Configuration Freeze
requirements.evidence: Config, compose, launcher, API and worker defaults resolve to the frozen flags; historical runs lack explicit reference_config_id.

requirements.title: Configuration Drift Audit
requirements.evidence: Configured and worker-resolved flags match; run-stamped provenance is incomplete for historical qualification runs.

requirements.title: Release Provenance
requirements.evidence: Run identity, benchmark, tier, flags, source revision and termination are available; reference_config_id is missing on legacy qualifying runs.

requirements.title: RC Regression Suite
requirements.evidence: Phase 17.0 qualifying data covers model comparison, AI-agent competition, multimodal manufacturing and low-altitude economy.

requirements.title: Regression Execution Cost
requirements.evidence: No new Phase 17.0 qualification was started; existing 10 qualifying runs were reused.

requirements.title: Regression Gate
requirements.evidence: Historical terminal/report gates pass; fresh deployment smoke did not produce a report.

requirements.title: Catastrophic Regression Definition
requirements.evidence: Historical family spread and low-altitude limitation are classified; no catastrophic RC quality regression was asserted.

requirements.title: Reliability Audit
requirements.evidence: Historical runs were terminal, but standard smoke observed ResearchLeaseLostError and quick smoke failed before report creation.

requirements.title: Timeout / Deadline Invariants
requirements.evidence: Quick smoke deadline elapsed without an explicit deadline terminal event; it later failed with REPORT_NO_ACCEPTED_EVIDENCE. This does not prove deadline semantics are reliable.

requirements.title: State Integrity
requirements.evidence: Gap/evidence/report/run persistence was audited; q1 was only aggregate-triaged and not fully user-visible-traced.

requirements.title: q1 Projection Issue
requirements.evidence: Recorded as non-release-impact known issue, but the requested full user-visible impact trace is not complete.

requirements.title: Report Integrity
requirements.evidence: 9/10 qualifying historical runs have verified reports; fresh quick smoke had no report and cannot be fetched.

requirements.title: Observability Audit
requirements.evidence: Historical lifecycle events are present; smoke failure/lease-loss path lacks a fully verified terminal/report event chain.

requirements.title: Provider Failure Interpretation
requirements.evidence: 157 provider failures were mostly absorbed by fallback; 9/10 qualifying runs produced verified reports; classified as operational noise for historical qualification.

requirements.title: Low-Altitude Known Limitation
requirements.evidence: Documented as coverage 0.25 +/- 0.1782, with affected family and user-visible limitation.

requirements.title: Run-to-Run Variance
requirements.evidence: Variance metrics are recorded; engineering-cause attribution is not fully separated for every signal.

requirements.title: Variance Classification
requirements.evidence: External/provider variance is documented; a complete per-signal classification artifact is not present.

requirements.title: Release Hygiene Task
requirements.evidence: Historical Phase 15.2 lint issue was explicitly handled as excluded one-off tooling.

requirements.title: Historical Script Decision
requirements.evidence: correct_phase15_2_comparability.py is documented as one-off historical analysis and excluded through an explicit pyproject rule.

requirements.title: Quality Gates
requirements.evidence: pytest, ruff, mypy apps/api, Phase 17 script mypy and git diff --check passed; exclusion is documented.

requirements.title: Dead / Experimental Feature Audit
requirements.evidence: independent_source_targeting is ACTIVE_V1; evidence-aware context and input-quality flags are EXPERIMENTAL_DISABLED.

requirements.title: No Large Refactor
requirements.evidence: No Phase 17.1 architecture/schema rewrite was introduced.

requirements.title: Known Issues Registry
requirements.evidence: artifacts/v1_known_issues.md exists and records low-altitude, variance, per-claim verification, q1, lint and provenance issues.

requirements.title: Known Issue Classification
requirements.evidence: Issues are classified as LIMITATION, EXPECTED_VARIANCE, ARCHITECTURAL_V2, BUG/TRIAGE or RELEASE_HYGIENE.

requirements.title: V2 Backlog Freeze
requirements.evidence: V2 capability items are recorded, but a separate bounded V2 backlog artifact is not present.

requirements.title: Release Documentation
requirements.evidence: README, env example, compose and issue docs exist; a single complete V1 RC architecture/runtime/reproducibility guide was not verified.

requirements.title: Deployment Smoke
requirements.evidence: Compose/services/API/DB/worker passed; quick smoke 01a0c9ad-2018-7730-a8ef-1066181f4cc7 reached terminal failed REPORT_NO_ACCEPTED_EVIDENCE and produced no report.

requirements.title: Smoke Independent of Local State
requirements.evidence: Compose and migrations were checked, but the full clean-config create-to-report chain did not pass.

requirements.title: Fresh Environment Readiness
requirements.evidence: Compose config, env defaults and startup were checked; clean clone/startup equivalence was not fully executed.

requirements.title: Database Migration Audit
requirements.evidence: Database revision 20260918_0025 is the single Alembic head and is accessible from the API container.

requirements.title: Release Version Identity
requirements.evidence: RC identity is v1.0.0-rc.1 with source revision v28-search-fallback-proxy-and-bing-parser.

requirements.title: Git / Working Tree Audit
requirements.evidence: Working tree contains many untracked phase/temp artifacts and local modifications; release inventory is not cleanly separated.

requirements.title: Secret Scan
requirements.evidence: Pattern scan was noisy and not a clean release-aware secret audit; no confirmed secret was promoted, but a formal clean result is missing.

requirements.title: Release Artifact Inventory
requirements.evidence: Core source/migrations/compose/env/docs/benchmark artifacts exist; temporary scratch files remain in the working tree and need release exclusion.

requirements.title: Blocker Classification
requirements.evidence: The corrected audit uses P0/P1/P2/V2 categories.

requirements.title: P0 Definition
requirements.evidence: Deployment smoke report unavailability and unproven terminalization are treated as release-blocking until resolved.

requirements.title: P1 Definition
requirements.evidence: Legacy provenance, documentation and working-tree hygiene are separated as P1 items where applicable.

requirements.title: P2 Definition
requirements.evidence: Low-altitude weakness and run variance remain non-blocking P2 limitations.

requirements.title: Research Quality Not Coding Trigger
requirements.evidence: No Phase 17.1 change was justified by ordinary coverage variation.

requirements.title: RC Regression Artifacts
requirements.evidence: Required regression, reliability, known-issues and release-gate artifacts exist; this audit adds the missing 1-52 compliance artifact.

requirements.title: Pre-existing Artifacts Preserved
requirements.evidence: Historical Phase 15/16/17.0 artifacts were retained.

requirements.title: Test Requirements
requirements.evidence: Tests cover config defaults, propagation, provenance, terminalization, report, drift, release metadata and feature defaults.

requirements.title: Final Gates
requirements.evidence: Static gates pass; deployment smoke does not pass the required create-to-report sequence.

requirements.title: No New Quality Qualification
requirements.evidence: No seven-family or Phase 17.0 requalification was run.

requirements.title: Release Gate
requirements.evidence: Deployment smoke and report integrity are not fully passing; configuration provenance is incomplete.

requirements.title: Three-way RC Decision
requirements.evidence: Corrected decision is V1 RC NOT READY, not READY or READY WITH KNOWN ISSUES.

requirements.title: Final Report Format
requirements.evidence: This corrected report includes sections A-N and the blocker table.

requirements.title: Ten Final Questions
requirements.evidence: Each question is answered below with PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL and evidence.

requirements.title: Closeout Discipline
requirements.evidence: No new optimization phase or research-intelligence work is opened; blockers are limited to release hardening.

requirements.title: STOP
requirements.evidence: No release, public deployment, production tag, V2 or Phase 16/17.2 work is started.
